name: Staff Request with Manager Sign-off
description: A general-purpose intake process for requests raised by staff (equipment, software access, training, travel or other), triaged by the service desk, signed off by the requester's line manager, with a second sign-off by finance above a cost threshold, then fulfilled and closed with a written outcome.

intent.outcome: Every request raised by a member of staff reaches a recorded decision by their line manager (and finance where the cost is material), is either fulfilled by the service desk or declined with a reason, and leaves an auditable outcome summary against the requester and the reference number.
intent.respondents: Employees and contractors raising a request about their own work needs

assumptions.statement: "Requests from staff" means internal work requests (equipment, software access, training, travel, other) rather than HR matters such as leave, grievances or pay changes, which usually need different data and different approvers.
assumptions.affects: data.fields request_type choices, experience pages, absence of any restricted health or payroll fields

assumptions.statement: The line manager who signs off is identified by an email address typed on the form by the requester, because no org-chart lookup was described.
Manager sign-off alone is enough below an estimated cost of 1000; at or above that a finance approver also signs off.
assumptions.affects: workflow transitions manager_approved_standard / manager_approved_high_value, role finance_approver

assumptions.statement: A service desk triage step exists before the manager sees the request, so incomplete or unclear requests are returned to the requester rather than wasting manager time.
assumptions.affects: state with_service_desk, task triage_request, state returned_to_requester

assumptions.statement: Service desk responds within 1 working day, managers within 3 days, fulfilment within 5 days; requests with no manager decision after 10 days expire.
assumptions.affects: state slaHours values and all timer transitions

assumptions.statement: Supporting evidence is recorded as a quote or catalogue reference rather than uploaded, so no attachments are collected.
assumptions.affects: data.fields supporting_reference, absence of file fields

assumptions.statement: Costs are captured as a single estimated amount in GBP rather than itemised lines.

openDecisions.question: What kinds of request does this actually cover, and are there types that need a different approver (for example anything touching payroll, access to personal data, or safety equipment)?
openDecisions.provisionally: Five generic request types with an 'other' free-text explanation, all routed to the line manager

openDecisions.question: What is the real value threshold above which finance must also approve, and who is the finance approver?
openDecisions.provisionally: Threshold set at 1000 with a single finance_approver role

openDecisions.question: Should a request be blocked if the named line manager is not actually the requester's manager?
openDecisions.provisionally: No validation; the service desk checks this during triage and can return the request for correction

openDecisions.question: Are the SLA and expiry durations (1 / 3 / 5 / 10 days) acceptable to the business?
openDecisions.provisionally: Used as placeholders in every timer transition; easy to change in one place per state

openDecisions.question: Does fulfilment need to hand off to another system (purchasing, IT provisioning) rather than being closed manually by the service desk?
openDecisions.provisionally: A request.fulfilled webhook event is emitted so a downstream system can pick it up, but fulfilment is completed as a human task

fields.help: We send all updates about this request to this address.

Tell us what kind of request this is
One-line summary of your request

fields.help: Your manager decides from this text, so say what the request is for and what happens if it is not approved.

Quote, catalogue or course reference

Request reference
fields.help: Generated when the request is submitted and quoted in every message.

pages.title: About you
pages.description: So we know who is asking and who signs it off.

sections.title: Cost
sections.description: An estimate is fine. Give us a reference where the price can be checked.

confirmation.message: Thanks — your request is with the service desk. We check it within one working day and then send it to your line manager for sign-off. You will get an email at every step.

states.name: Back with the requester for changes

tasks.name: Triage the request
tasks.description: Check the request is clear, the named line manager is right, and the cost has a checkable reference. Record what you found in the triage note, then complete this task to send it for sign-off, or return the request for changes.

tasks.name: Fulfil the approved request
tasks.description: Arrange, order or provision what was approved. Record what was provided and when in the fulfilment note, then complete this task to close the request.

email.name: Request received
email.subject: We have your request {{reference_number}}: {{request_summary}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

We have your request ({{reference_number}}) for: {{request_summary}}.

The service desk will check it within one working day, then send it to {{line_manager_email}} for sign-off. You need it by {{needed_by_date}}, so if we have not confirmed a decision within three working days, reply to this email and we will chase it.

Service desk

email.name: Manager: sign-off needed
email.subject: Sign-off needed: {{requester_name}} - {{request_summary}} ({{reference_number}})

email.name: Manager reminder
email.subject: Still waiting on you: {{reference_number}} - {{request_summary}}
email.body:
Request {{reference_number}} from {{requester_name}} is still waiting for your sign-off. It is needed by {{needed_by_date}}.

If there is no decision within 10 days of it reaching you, we close the request and {{requester_name}} has to start again.

Service desk

email.name: Finance: sign-off needed
email.subject: Finance sign-off needed: {{reference_number}} ({{estimated_cost}})

email.name: Finance reminder
email.subject: Reminder: finance sign-off for {{reference_number}}
email.body:
Request {{reference_number}} ({{estimated_cost}}) is still waiting for finance sign-off. It is needed by {{needed_by_date}}.

Service desk

email.name: More information needed
email.subject: We need a bit more on request {{reference_number}}

email.name: Reminder: your request is waiting on you
email.subject: Reminder: request {{reference_number}} is waiting on you
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} still needs the changes we asked for: {{triage_note}}

Update and save it to send it back to us. We will close it if we hear nothing within 14 days of our first message.

Service desk

email.name: Request approved
email.subject: Approved: {{reference_number}} - {{request_summary}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} ({{request_summary}}) has been approved.

Approver's note: {{decision_note}}

The service desk is now arranging it and aims to have it done within five working days, ahead of your needed-by date of {{needed_by_date}}.

Service desk

email.name: Request declined
email.subject: Declined: {{reference_number}} - {{request_summary}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} ({{request_summary}}) has been declined.

Reason given: {{decision_note}}

If your circumstances change, talk to {{line_manager_email}} first and then raise a new request.

Service desk

email.name: Request fulfilled
email.subject: Done: {{reference_number}} - {{request_summary}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} is complete.

What we did: {{fulfilment_note}}

A one-page summary is attached for your records. If anything is missing or wrong, reply within five working days and we will reopen it.

Service desk

email.name: Request closed with no response
email.subject: Closed with no decision: {{reference_number}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} ({{request_summary}}) has been closed because we did not get the decision or information needed in time.

Nothing has been ordered or arranged. If you still need this, raise a new request and let us know who should sign it off.

Service desk

email.name: Request withdrawn
email.subject: Withdrawn: {{reference_number}}
email.body:
Hi {{requester_name}},

Request {{reference_number}} ({{request_summary}}) has been withdrawn and closed. Nothing has been ordered or arranged.

Service desk

email.name: Service desk: triage overdue
email.subject: Triage overdue: {{reference_number}} ({{request_type}})
email.body: Request {{reference_number}} from {{requester_name}} has been waiting for triage for more than one working day. Needed by {{needed_by_date}}. Please triage it or return it to the requester today.

email.name: Service desk: fulfilment overdue
email.subject: Fulfilment overdue: {{reference_number}}
email.body: Approved request {{reference_number}} ({{request_summary}}) has been open for fulfilment for more than five working days. Needed by {{needed_by_date}}. Please update the fulfilment note and close it, or tell the requester what is holding it up.
